description.value:
Rank 4 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 40 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon that you are proficient with.
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Range: 1 Target that you can see or 1 Target that you can find through Sense Ki.
  • Duration: Instantaneous
  • Chargeable: Yes

Your attacks strike with the force to open wormholes. Make a number of Combo Attack Roll equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded up, against a target in range. On each hit, they take your Weapon Damage Die + 1d6 Ki Damage.

system.range: 1 Target that you can see or 1 Target that you can find through *Sense Ki.*
